questions.question: Which among the following is used as a fining agent in wine?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gelatin.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Fining is a winemaking process that aims to clarify and stabilize the wine.
 
• A fining agent is a range of special materials added to the juice that enables the process of fining.
 
• Because of fining, the wine is less likely to become hazy or cloudy after bottling and therefore more visually appealing.
 
• Fining also removes hydrogen sulfide and bitter flavors.
 
• The most common time a fining agent is added to wine is right after the fermentation has ended or a few days before bottling. 
 
• Some common Fining Agents are- 
 
 
• **Gelatine**
 
• Isinglass
 
• Egg white (egg albumen)
 
• Casein
 
• Skim milk
 
• Bentonite
 
• Carbon

questions.question: The deficiency of which of the following vitamins causes night blindness?

__
 
• **Night blindness** is the inability to see well at night or in poor lighting conditions. 
 
• Night blindness is also called **nyctalopia**.
 
• Night blindness is often caused by** Vitamin A** deficiency.
 
• Night blindness is also caused by nearsightedness or cataracts.
 
• Foods that provide **Vitamin A** are **carrots, sweet potatoes, eggs, milk, milk products,** etc.

questions.question: The musical instrument 'Kartal' from the state of Rajasthan comes under the category of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**idiophones.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kartal (as shown in the image below) is an ancient clapper instrument, with wooden or plastic handles, mainly used in devotional or folk songs.
 
• This wooden clapper is a Ghana Vadya which has discs or plates that produce a clinking sound when clapped together. 
 
• It comes under the category of **Idiophones**. 
 
• Idiophones are instruments whose own substance vibrates to produce sound. 
 
• Some examples of idiophones are** bells, clappers, rattles, etc. **

 [IMAGE: https://kaaynamusicals.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/K2.jpg] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Membranophones **- Membranophones emit sound by the vibration of a stretched membrane. For example, drums.
 
• **Electrophones **- An electronic musical instrument or electrophone is a musical instrument that produces sound using electronic circuitry. For example, electric guitar. 
 
• **Chordophones **- A chordophone is a class of musical instruments in which a stretched, vibrating string produces the initial sound. For example, guitar, sitar, etc.

questions.question: One-third of the members of the Vidhan Parishad retire every ______ year/s.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**two.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Vidhan Parishad or the State Legislative Council is the upper house in those states that have a bicameral legislature.
 
• The tenure of Members of Legislative Council (MLC) is **six years**. One-third of the members of the State Legislative Council retire after every two years.
 
• This arrangement is similar to that of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Parliament of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The establishment of the State Legislative Council is defined in **Article 169** of the Constitution of India.
 
• As of 2022, **6 out of 28 states have a State Legislative Council. **These are **Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Telangana, Maharashtra, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• To become a member of a State Legislative Council (MLC), a person must be a citizen of India, and at least 30 years old.

questions.question: Which of the following file formats does MS Paint use to open and save files in Windows?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is .__**JPEG.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Microsoft Paint is a simple graphics editor that has been included with all versions of Microsoft Windows. 
 
• The file format used by MS-Paint to open and save a file is **.JPEG**. 
 
• JPEG stands for **Joint Photographic Experts Group. **
 
• It is the most commonly used format of photos. 
 
• Other formats are **PNG (Portable Network Graphics)**, **GIF (Graphics Interchange Format)**, **TIFF (Tagged Image File**), **PSD (Photoshop Document)**, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PPT **- This file format is created by MS-Powerpoint. 
 
• **DOC **- This is a word processing document format created by Microsoft Word
 
• **XLS **- This is a spreadsheet file created by Microsoft Excel.

questions.question: Which sport was approved to be played at the 2024 Summer Olympics in Paris for the first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Breakdancing.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Breakdancing** is set to make its **debut **at** the 2024 Paris Olympic Games**.
 
• Breakdancing made its debut at the 2024 Paris Olympics, with B-girl Ami of Japan winning the inaugural breaking gold medal.
 
• Ami, whose legal name is **Ami Yuasa,** defeated Lithuania's B-girl **Nicka** (Dominika Banevič) in the **gold** medal battle.
 
• Before this, It was introduced at the **2018 Youth Olympics** in Buenos Aires. 
 
• Breakdancing, popularly known as breaking, is a form of dance sport that blends urban dance with remarkable athleticism. 
 
• Breakdancing started from the streets of New York in the **1970s**.
 
• However, unlike its beginning on the streets, it has evolved into a proper dance sport, with a fixed set of rules that make for fair competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cricket **- Cricket has been a sport at the modern Summer Olympic Games. The only time it has been played to date was at the 1900 Summer Olympics with only a men's contest, and **Great Britain** won the gold medal. 
 
• **Darts **- Darts or dart-throwing is a competitive sport in which two or more players bare-handedly throw small sharp-pointed missiles known as darts at a round target known as a dartboard. It has never been a part of the Olympic games. 
 
• **Parkour Race** - It is a casual video game where you compete in exciting races between very agile characters that jump over walls and obstacles and finish the race.

questions.question: ______ holds office from the date of his/her election till immediately before the first meeting of the Lok Sabha after the dissolution of the one to which he/she was elected.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The speaker of the Lok Sabha/legislative assembly vacates the office immediately before the first meeting of the newly elected house.
 
• After a general election and the formation of a newly elected house, a pro-tem or interim speaker is appointed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pro-tem is a Latin phrase that means **“for the time being”.**
 
• President/governor appoints the pro-tem speaker to preside over the sittings of the newly elected house.
 
• Usually, the **senior-most member** of the house is made the pro-tem speaker.
 
• The first meeting after the election when the Speaker and the Deputy Speaker are selected by members of the Parliament is held under the pro tem Speaker.
 
• The pro tem Speaker also administers the oath of office to the newly elected MPs.
 
• On the election of a new Speaker, the office of the pro tem speaker ceases to exist.
 
• The **Vice President** holds office for **five years**. The Vice President can be re-elected any number of times. However, the office may be terminated earlier by death, resignation, or removal. The Constitution does not provide a mechanism of succession to the office of Vice President in the event of an extraordinary vacancy, apart from re-election. However, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha can perform the Vice President's duties as the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha in such an event.

questions.question: Who among the following presided over the special session of Congress in September 1923 and at the age of 35 became the youngest man to be elected as the President of the Congress?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maulana Abul Kalam Azad.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Abul Kalam Azad presided over the Special Session of the Indian National Congress, held in **Delhi **in **1923**.
 
• In **1923**, at an age of **35**, he became the youngest person to serve as the President of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was also elected as the president of the **1940 **session in **Ramgarh**.
 
• Commonly regarded as Maulana Azad, the leader was conferred **Bharat Ratna (posthumously) in 1992**.
 
• He was a revolutionary poet, journalist, activist, and freedom fighter.
 
• He is credited for the formation of the **University Grants Commission** and the** Indian Institutes of Technology. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ram Manohar Lohia** - He was an activist in the Indian independence movement and a socialist political leader. Lohia was one of the founders of the **Congress Socialist Party. **
 
• **Mahadev Govind Ranade** - popularly referred to as **Justice Ranade**, was an Indian scholar, social reformer, judge, and author. He was one of the founding members of the **Indian National Congress party**. 
 
• **Bal Gangadhar Tilak **- He was popularly called **Lokmanya**. He was an Indian nationalist, teacher, and independence activist. The British colonial authorities called him **"The father of the Indian unrest."** Mahatma Gandhi called him **"The Maker of Modern India". **He is known for his quote in Marathi: **"Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it!".**

questions.question: As of January 2021, more than 93% of India’s chromite resources were located in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chromite **is the single commercially viable ore of chromium which is chemically known as** iron chromium oxide**. 
 
• More than **93 percent** of the Chromite resources in India are found in **Sukinda valley in Cuttack **and **Jajapur in Odisha. **
 
• Minor deposits are spread over **Manipur, Nagaland, Karnataka, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu**, and **Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It is a steel-grey, lustrous, hard, and brittle metal which takes a high polish, resists tarnishing, and has a high melting point.
 
• The properties of chromium that make it most versatile and indispensable are its resistance to corrosion, oxidation, and wear.
 
• Chromium is an important alloying metal. It is used in the manufacture of alloys along with other metals, such as nickel, cobalt, copper, etc.
 
• It is also used in many other metallurgical, refractories, and chemical industries.

questions.question: 'Per Drop More Crop' is the goal for which Government of India scheme?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY). **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Per Drop More Crop is a key component of **‘Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY). **
 
• To enhance the adoption of precision irrigation and other water-saving technologies, **Per Drop More Crop**, has been adopted. 
 
• PMKSY is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme on Micro Irrigation (CSS), first launched in **January 2006. **
 
• Centre- States funding ratio will be** 60:40 percent **and in the case of the north-eastern region and hilly states, it will be **90:10.**
 
• The scheme is being implemented by the **Department of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare (DAC&FW)** under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) **- Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) is a scheme launched by the Hon’ble Prime Minister on April 8, 2015, for providing loans up to 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro-enterprises. These loans are given by Commercial Banks, RRBs, Small Finance Banks, MFIs, and NBFCs. 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G) **- It is a social welfare program, created by the Indian Government, to provide housing for the rural poor in India. The central government came up with the vision to fulfill the **'Housing for All' **scheme by the year 2022. 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) **- It is a financial inclusion program of the Government of India open to Indian citizens, that aims to expand affordable access to financial services such as bank accounts, remittances, credit, insurance, and pensions. It was launched in **2014**.

questions.question: Which of the following is a computer application software?

__
 
• A word processor (WP) is a **computer program or application software** that provides for input, editing, formatting, and output of text, often with some additional features.
 
• An application program or software is a computer program designed to carry out a specific task other than one relating to the operation of the computer itself. 
 
• Some examples of application software are **media players, accounting software, spreadsheet software**, etc. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **RAM **- Random Access Memory (RAM) is a general-purpose memory that usually stores the user data in a program. RAM is volatile, which means it cannot retain data in the absence of power.

questions.question: Heat, in ______, is a type of energy transfer from a warmer substance to a colder one.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**thermodynamics.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Heat is the form of energy that is transferred between two substances at different temperatures.
 
• The direction of energy flow is from the substance of higher temperature to the substance of lower temperature.
 
• Heat is measured in units of energy, usually **calories **or **joules**.
 
• **Thermodynamics **is the** study of the relations between heat, work, temperature, and energy. **
 
• The laws of thermodynamics describe how the energy in a system changes and whether the system can perform useful work on its surroundings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnet **- A magnet is a material or object that produces a magnetic field that pulls on other ferromagnetic materials, such as iron, steel, nickel, cobalt, etc.
 
• **Friction **is a force between two surfaces that are sliding, or trying to slide, across each other.
 
• **Gravity** is the force by which a planet or other body draws objects toward its center. The force of gravity keeps all of the planets in orbit around the sun.

questions.question: In the Battle of Swally (1612) the British fought against the ______.

• It was a naval battle that was fought off the coast of Suvali a village near **Surat city, Gujarat, India. **
 
• It was a victory for the British East India Company over the Portuguese.

• **British and French Wars** - The **Carnatic Wars** were a series of military conflicts in the middle of the 18th century between the French East India Company and the British East India Company. They were mainly fought within the territories of Mughal India.

questions.question: Who among the following is India’s highest wicket taker in test cricket as of December 2020?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Anil Kumble.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Former Indian leg spinner and former coach of the Indian Team, **Anil Kumble **is the highest wicket-taker in test cricket. 
 
• He has taken** 619 wickets** in **132 matches** with a strike rate of 66.

questions.question: The National Education Policy (NEP), 2020 commits to raising the total expenditure by states and centre on education to ______ of GDP.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**6.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The National Education Policy 2020 has set the target to increase public investment in the education sector to reach** 6 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) **at the earliest.
 
• After almost three decades, the government is ready to transform the country's education system by making some impactful suggestions.
 
• While the National Education Policy 2020 (NEP 2020) aims at making India a global knowledge superpower by providing high-quality education to all.
 
• The policy focuses on almost **doubling **the **Gross Enrolment Ratio (GER)** in higher education, including vocational education, from **26.3 percent** to **50 percent by 2035.**
 
• Currently, the expenditure on education by centre and states as a proportion of GDP is **3.1 percent in 2019/20 (budget estimates)** and has inched up by a meagre 30 basis points in the past six years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross domestic product (GDP)** is the total monetary or market value of all the finished goods and services produced within a country's borders in a specific time period.
 
• As a broad measure of overall domestic production, it functions as a comprehensive scorecard of a given country's economic health.
